package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func sourcePolicy(t *testing.T) *SettingsPolicy {
	t.Helper()
	var countries []SettingsCountry
	var currencies []SettingsCurrency
	var raw map[string]string
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		body   string
		target any
	}{{sourceCountries, &countries}, {sourceCurrencies, &currencies}, {sourceDefaults, &raw}} {
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(tc.body), tc.target); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	values := url.Values{}
	for _, key := range []string{"name", "bio", "email", "email_is_public", "address", "city", "postal_code", "country[code]", "region", "currency"} {
		if value, ok := raw[key]; ok {
			values[key] = []string{value}
		}
	}
	initial, err := ParseSettingsValues(values)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p, err := NewSettingsPolicy(countries, currencies, initial)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return p
}

func renderSourceForm(t *testing.T, p *SettingsPolicy, v SettingsValues, show bool) string {
	t.Helper()
	component, err := NewSettingsForm(p, v, SettingsPresentation{ID: "fixture", Action: "/settings", ResetAction: "/settings/reset", CSRFToken: "synthetic-only", ShowErrors: show, ErrorClass: sourceErrorClass})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var b bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &b); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b.String()
}

func TestCompleteSourceNativeRender(t *testing.T) {
	p := sourcePolicy(t)
	body := renderSourceForm(t, p, p.Initial(), false)
	if err := os.WriteFile("rendered-default.html", []byte(body), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if body != renderSourceForm(t, p, p.Initial(), false) {
		t.Fatal("render output drift")
	}
	for _, heading := range []string{"Settings", "Organization Name", "Organization Bio", "Organization Email", "Address", "Currency"} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, ">"+heading+"</h") {
			t.Fatalf("lost source section %s", heading)
		}
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"name", "bio", "email", "email_is_public", "address", "city", "postal_code", "country[code]", "region", "currency"} {
		if strings.Count(body, `name="`+key+`"`) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("missing/duplicate native field %s", key)
		}
	}
	if strings.Count(body, "<section") != 5 || strings.Count(body, "<select") != 3 || strings.Count(body, `type="checkbox"`) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("incomplete native form")
	}
	for _, unexpected := range []string{`role="checkbox"`, `role="combobox"`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `name="country[regions]`, `name="country[name]"`, `<noscript`, `<script`} {
		if strings.Contains(body, unexpected) {
			t.Fatalf("source controller authority leaked: %s", unexpected)
		}
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"bio", "email", "country", "region", "currency"} {
		if strings.Count(body, `id="fixture-`+key+`"`) != 1 || strings.Count(body, `id="fixture-`+key+`-error"`) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("missing/repeated field or error ID %s", key)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(body, `fixture-`+key+`-error"`) {
			t.Fatalf("missing error association %s", key)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(body, `for="fixture-email_is_public"`) || !strings.Contains(body, `id="fixture-email_is_public"`) {
		t.Fatal("checkbox association lost")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(body, `formaction="/settings/reset"`) || !strings.Contains(body, `value="reset"`) || !strings.Contains(body, `value="validate"`) {
		t.Fatal("native action fallback lost")
	}
	if strings.Count(body, "<optgroup") != len(p.Countries()) {
		t.Fatal("no-JS region choices incomplete")
	}
	for _, country := range p.Countries() {
		for _, region := range country.Regions {
			if !strings.Contains(body, ">"+region+"</option>") {
				t.Fatal("canonical region lost")
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestCompleteSourceDraftAndFocus(t *testing.T) {
	p := sourcePolicy(t)
	values := p.Initial()
	values.Name = `</input><script>not-code</script>`
	values.Bio = strings.Repeat("😀", 241) + `</textarea><script>not-code</script>`
	values.Email = "invalid example"
	values.Country = "ZZ"
	values.Region = "<unknown>"
	body := renderSourceForm(t, p, values, true)
	if err := os.WriteFile("rendered-errors.html", []byte(body), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if strings.Contains(body, "<script>") || !strings.Contains(body, "&lt;script&gt;") {
		t.Fatal("draft escaped incorrectly")
	}
	if strings.Count(body, "autofocus") != 1 {
		t.Fatal("expected one first-error focus")
	}
	start := strings.Index(body, "<textarea")
	if start < 0 {
		t.Fatal("biography control missing")
	}
	end := strings.Index(body[start:], ">") + start
	if end < start || !strings.Contains(body[start:end], "autofocus") || !strings.Contains(body[start:end], `aria-invalid="true"`) {
		t.Fatal("first invalid biography focus missing")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(body, strings.Repeat("😀", 241)) || !strings.Contains(body, "&lt;unknown&gt; (invalid)") {
		t.Fatal("invalid draft shortened/coerced")
	}
}

func TestCompleteSourceMultipleInstances(t *testing.T) {
	p := sourcePolicy(t)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, prefix := range []string{"first", "second"} {
		component, err := NewSettingsForm(p, p.Initial(), SettingsPresentation{ID: prefix, Action: "/settings", ResetAction: "/settings/reset", CSRFToken: "synthetic-only"})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var b bytes.Buffer
		if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &b); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, match := range regexp.MustCompile(`\sid="([^"]+)"`).FindAllStringSubmatch(b.String(), -1) {
			id := match[1]
			if seen[id] || !strings.HasPrefix(id, prefix+"-") {
				t.Fatal("repeated instance has a static or colliding ID")
			}
			seen[id] = true
		}
	}
}
